title: Area
body:
Syntax: area create <name> [size] | area export <area name> | area import <file.json> [check] | area assign <name> <builder account> | area unassign <name> <builder account> | area prototype <name> on|off | area list | area delete <name> <confirmation code>

Description: Areas reserve room vnum ranges. New manually created areas start as prototypes; existing system areas are live. Biran assigns one Builder account to each area and can switch its prototype flag. Builders can edit and move only within assigned ranges, including mob and item prototype vnums. They can connect two prototype areas when both have the same assigned owner. Only Biran can connect a prototype to a live area or another builder's area. Area delete is reserved for Biran's Implementor account and requires the private deletion code. It permanently removes the reservation, rooms, live mobs and ground items there, incoming exits, spawn points, and exclusive prototypes. Connected players move to a surviving room; the deletion persists after reboot. Use area set <name> income <n> or resetmsg <text|off> for area settings.

Offline editor: An Implementor uses 'area export <area name>' to write a JSON package under data/area_exports/. Copy it to your computer and open it with builder/Nindo_Area_Builder.html using Open / import area JSON. Edit rooms, exits, recognized room flags, and placed mob/item prototypes, then export JSON into data/area_imports/. Run 'area import <file.json> check' first and then 'area import <file.json>' to apply. An existing area update protects against stale exports, preserves advanced settings, and refuses missing existing rooms or prototypes. A new package may only use unused VNUMs.

Date: 2026-10-04
